raw_text: I hate you you motherfuckers.

Great location! Frederika was really nice and welcoming, along with her two children. The listing did say that the guest room was on a separate floor away from the chaos, but it was right next to where the children were sleeping and I felt almost as if I was intruding on their privacy. The shower would not drain properly, either. The wifi did not work in the bedroom I was in at all. Zero chance I could work there if needed. It’s a very small space and I truly do not believe it should be available to travelers. I ended up leaving early, to give them their privacy, as I know Frederika will no longer be renting out due to her two kids. Wishing them all the best :)
Normal y limpio

Frederika was a very welcoming and accommodating host—although I did not spend much time with her. The apartment is in a great location and the bathroom was kept clean. A couple downsides: there was no heating and the linens did not smell like they had been washed recently.
finalmente no nos pudimos hospedar en casa de Frederika pero fue muy amable y sus respuestas fueron muy rápidas.

Frederika war eine sehr angenehme Gasstgeberin und ich habe mich wohl und willkommen gefühlt.
Das Zimmer ist geräumig, sauber und hat einen tollen Blick und alles ist genau wie beschrieben. Es war alles da, was man braucht, einschliesslich eines Haarföns. Schönes, sauberes Bad.
Das Baby wachte täglich um 7 Uhr auf und war auch nicht zu überhören. Wenn man leichten Schlaf hat würde ich Ohrenstöpsel empfehlen. WiFi funktioniert im Zimmer schlecht bis gar nicht, im Rest der Wohnung einwandfrei.

The apartment is very centrally located, making it really easy to get around (to and from). I was mainly in London for work during this stay so it suited me well. The room is large, with a great expansive view to the east of London.

I enjoyed my stay at Frederika's. The apartment is very central and has great access to the Shoreditch nightlife area as well as key underground stations. If you are visiting through King's Cross, this is a great place because it is only a subway stop away. Obviously it is in the city, so there is some street noise, and the apartment does have 3 half flights of stairs, so if you are stair impaired this might be a tough place to stay. Alex was very well behaved. Overall it's a solid value for the money and the views are fantastic.

Frederika's apartment was perfect for my short stay in London. It is ideally situated close to multiple public transport options, yet within comfortable walking distance (weather permitting, of course) of central London. The space itself is clean, comfortable, and quiet -- big and comfy bed! -- with a wonderful view of East London. And, of course, Alex was delightful. Hartelijk bedankjes!

Frederika has been extreamly friendly in her welcome and care of my daughter for the week she stayed there. I confirm that the room is really nice and cosy and the view fantastic. The flat is well securised (entrances) and extreamly well located in London (5mn walking distance from Old Street Underground station). She showed us all useful local facilities. Her daughter Alex is a beautiful and sparkling smiling child. :) I warmly recommand her place in London.
Frederika was a very welcoming host and the little landlord (no longer pint-sized) is really sweet and very quiet! The views from both the guest bedroom and the kitchen/living room are both great!
A lovely stay in a lovely flat. Great host, very amenable, kind and friendly. Brilliant directions and a great view. Shame I could only stay one night. Thank you for having me.
Brilliant location! Very friendly host.

Best location, very warm host, fantastic view and a good price.
Best place from Airbnb I've ever been in London!

This was my second stay at Frederika’s place and once again, I was made to feel very much at home by Frederika’s friendliness and hospitality. I am utterly enchanted by wonderful little Alex. I sincerely hope I will have another opportunity to stay with them both again in the future. Thank you for making me feel like part of the family Frederika and Alex.
This is my fav. airbnb! Felt like home :) Very good location and good price!

Frederika is an absolutely lovely host who goes above and beyond to make you comfortable. The location is also perfect - i walked everywhere. This is really good value for money and I'll definitely be back.

Had a great time visiting London and staying at Frederika’s Airbnb.   Location is great, and easy ride from the airport.   Nice lace with great views of the city, walkable distance to all the places I wanted to visit.   Frederika and Alex were very hospitable.

I have really enjoyed my staying in this place. It's extremely central, clean and the room very bright with amazing city view in the morning and  sky view at night! Frederika is very friendly and was replying to my messages on the spot anytime.

I was made to feel very welcome, and the room description was totally accurate. It was just like being at home. The location is great for getting around central London, either for business or as a tourist. Thank you Frederika and Alex for your hospitality!
Fantastic host in a convenient and trendy location near Shoreditch and other major attractions. Would highly recommend staying here!
Very friendly and knowledgeable about the local area. Nice room in great location.

I enjoyed my stay, absolutely no complaints. The flat was clean and comfortable with a comfortable bed, nice bathroom and kitchen. I was particularly impressed by the newly decorated bathroom. The flat also has spectacular views of the London skyline. Frederica was a fabulous host, she was in when I arrived and was very welcoming and well informed about the local area.

The flat was nicer than I expected from the air b and b description. I was aware of the skyline but less aware of the positive condition of the flat.

The location of the flat is another positive point. I was in town for an event in the city, the location could not have been better, no more than 2 minutes’ walk from old street tube station and a short walk from many of London’s attractions including the Barbican.

Frederika and here li'l daughter were wonderful and friendly hosts. The apartment provides stunning views over the roofs of most buildings in London in west and east direction, with attractions like the London Eye to be seen in the distance. A nice small touch was the European power plug converter next to the bed stand.

I stayed at Frederika’s place for 1 week and was happy with everything about the stay.
Frederika and Alex (her 3 year old daughter) were both excellent hosts. The room and bathroom were always clean and the bed was comfortable. Frederika has some great local tips and insight about London. Although this is a room with a shared bathroom, I always felt that I had privacy.
Overall, everything was great, thank you!
I felt really comfortable living in Frederika’s place.
Amazing View and perfect Location for City exploring.

Great location in central London and you will spend time with a lovely person
I recommend this place
Great host and great location - comfortable and spacious room with wonderful views and you couldn’t find a friendlier host.
Lovely room with great views and a generous and welcoming host

Two fabulous people in a wonderful space in a great location. I was attending a conference at the Guildhall and could have stayed in a budget hotel - so glad I didn’t! This is a wonderful space, quiet and restful and warm and welcoming, with dizzying views. Frederika made me feel immediately welcome, as did little Alex, who already has her mother’s warmth, wit, and generosity. I would return any time and recommend it to anyone. One of the best stays I have ever had in London.
Great host in a great location for a good price!

Ich war für 2 Nächte bei Frederika und alles lief absolut problemlos. Die Unterkunft ist ca. 3 min Fußweg von der U-Bahn-Station Old Street entfernt und man hat wirklich einen tollen Ausblick aus dem 13. Stock. Frederika war absolut unkompliziert und Kommunikation / Schlüsselübergabe hat bestens geklappt. Ihre kleine Tochter ist sehr süß und ruhig und ich hab kaum mitbekommen, das ein kleines Baby nebenan schläft. Ein großes Dankeschön an Frederika und ich wünsch ihr alles Liebe & Gute. Ich komm gern wieder, wenn ich wieder in London bin.

The host is so nice and the night view from the house is so impressive. You can see the city right through your room window. And the neighbors are really kind to help. A great choice to stay in London.
Great communication from Fredericka and great location.

Excellent location in central London.
The flat was clean, the room spacious and Frederika and her baby were really nice hosts.
If you are going to stay in central London, I would recommend it

There's a reason why Frederika is a super host - she accepted my request in the short term, gave me lots of helpful tips, lent me an adapter for my phone, and, most importantly, she made me feel welcome from the start. The view is amazing!
I would stay at her place again.
Thank you again and greetings to Alex!
Mareike
Great location for shoreditch and the city. Great comms and easy check in
Thanks for everything!
It was nice and comfy stay at Fredrika's place. Specially small Alex was really very cute!!
Good host, friendly place, clean and comfortable. I spent one night , had good night sleep and lovely company in the end of day. No problems.
Amazing view, friendly host and right in the city

I highly recommend staying with Frederika. It was a joy as she goes out of her way to help and make excellent recommendations such as the street market for a great lunch which turns into dinner as well.
Her daughter is sweet, funny and quiet. The room has an amazing view over London and is a good size and warm and cosy. The bed is super comfortable with great bed linen, towels and nice touches of soap and treats. Everything you could possibly need is a short walk away! I would return in an instant!

Convenient location, friendly host, useful tips for London (eg Barbican nearby & other walkable destinations). Thoughtful touches like kleenex. Nice large towels. Comfy queen size bed. Warm comforter. Amazing natural light. Nice large windows and expansive city views. Nice conversations. Nice separation of living area and guest room if you need quiet time. Kind and thoughtful host.

Frederika is a very nice host and her baby is cute and not disturbing at all. The view is amazing and the flat is very quiet and clean.  It is exactly as described. The location was perfect for me and I appreciated a lot my stay to Frederika and her advice. I recommend it. Thomas (and Corinne)
Good room, good location, made very welcome. Thank you!
Great view, very friendly, easy communication. It was a pleasure staying with Frederika and Alex!

Staying with Frederika was a wonderful experience.  She was extremely welcoming, even meeting me at the train station to help me manage my bags.  During my stay she constantly gave me suggestions for things to do and see, and we even visited a museum together one day.  On top of the fact that Frederika is an amazing host, the location is fantastic - it is very easy to get to anywhere in central London via public transport or walking.  My time in London was fantastic, in no small part thanks to Frederika.

Lovely room in a well-located area, easy to get around via the Tube and bus services. Frederika was extremely helpful in providing local tips and recommendations. Loved waking up to the amazing views every morning :)
Lovely space, great location, great hostess.
Frederika & Alex were wonderful hosts, and made me feel very welcome. The flat has amazing views of London and I really enjoyed my stay.

Cozy room with a comfortable bed in a great location! Frederika is friendly and accommodating. The subway station is only 2-3 min walk away, making it convenient for all. I would recommend her place and would stay here again on future visits to London.

It was really nice to stay with Frederika and Alex. I arrived and Alex (about 4 years old?) walked me through all of the amenities of the room, including WiFi, maps, and bedside mints. Adorable! :)
I was pretty jetlagged and self-conscious about it. I was lucky that Frederika had a warm and chatty friend who was visiting. He taught me all about the history of the neighborhood and lots of fun anecdotes. He was over for dinner with a few other neighborhood friends and Frederika was so hospitable to invite me to the dinner! Her Chana masala was amazing as well! :)
Her place is really nice. Great views, modern bathroom, and designer and artistic touches in the rooms. If you're looking to be in Shoreditch, it's in the middle of everything.
Frederika and little Alex are the perfect hosts - warm and helpful - and their place is just the ideal place you would want to call home! Such a lovely experience!
Wonderful place to stay

Great location, close to Barbican and Old Road tube stations, 5 min. walk from the Barbican. Nice and cool room during a heatwave :) Frederika is a great host, relaxed, and serves a wonderfully healthy breakfast! The flat is quiet with amazing views over London. I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay. Thanks Frederika!

Frederika's place was perfectly located - far enough away from the noise of the city, but close enough to everything you could need and want. The house was very comfortable with incredible views (especially in the morning and evening). I didn't get much of a chance to speak to Frederika as I wasn't in the apartment a great deal but she was very friendly and helpful, even before I had arrived. The bed is super comfortable! Highly recommend Frederika's place.

If you are a little apprehensive about staying in an apartment with a 2 year old, don't be! Alex was absolutely lovely at the same time if you were in your room, you couldn't hear them if they were around.
If you want to stay in the shoreditch area the location is excellent and the mattress was really comfy!
Thanks for a great stay Frederika and Alex!
I had a very pleasant stay. The bed is comfortable and Frederika is a nice host. Looking forward to book again.

Ich war für knapp eine Woche bei Frederika in London. Ich kann absolut nichts schlechtes berichten. Alles war sauber und gepflegt. Frederika war während ich dort war immer hilfsbereit, egal was war. Was ich nicht dabei hatte oder vergessen habe hat sie mir geliehen (Adapter für Steckdosen, Regenschirm etc), sie konnte mir auf einer Karte immer zeigen wo ich finde was ich gesucht habe.
Alles in Allem war es die perfekte Wahl für meinen Aufenthalt in London! Würde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.

I stayed only 3 days at Frederika’s place for a work trip in Old Street, for which the flat was very conveniently located. Frederika was very welcoming and little Alex was absolutely adorable. As I was working long hours  I did not interact with them as much as I would have liked to ; still thanks to Frederika I discovered the nearby Bunhill Fields cemetery which I did not know about (despite having worked in the area for a year)! The room was nice and comfortable and the views are stunning. I would definitely recommend anyone to stay there!

Frederika was a great host who made me feel welcome with lots of tips about what to do in London and even gave me chocolate as a welcome present! Baby Alex is very sweet and well behaved. The views of London were also stunning.

Frederika was so kind and quick to respond when I booked last minute. The room had a lovely view and I woke on my last day to one of the best sunrises I have ever seen. There are restaurants near by and easy access to transportation to other parts of London. I really enjoyed my stay here!
Highly recommend to anyone looking for a short stay in London. Location and views are amazing, wonderful hospitality.

Great spot, ideal for me - I was working at offices in the Barbican. Excellent views, clean and Fred made my stay nice and easy - like checking in, fitting around my availability. Fred has a baby, a lovely kid. I didn't hear a peep from her during my stay. Would happily stay here again.
Sympathique accueil de Frederika, l'appartement est original dans sa structure, très propre et situé a 2mn a pied d'une station de métro. Frederika donne de bons renseignements sur Londres.
Nice and very friendly. Apartment is unusual, great view over London.
Wonderfully friendly and warm
A great, uncomplicated and quiet stay in central London with a breathtaking view. The rooms are large and clean. Nothing was missing. A sympathetic, nice family. Highly recommended.
Excellent location, extremely kind host and her adorable little daughter. I felt like I was at home!

Frederika's flat is a great value for a solo visitor looking for a well-located, clean and safe option near the center of London. Frederika is super friendly and accommodating - and there's a spectacular view from the room too!

Great place to stay! Frederika was so quick to respond to all of my questions and was so helpful with info once I arrived including some handy maps of the city. The location was perfect - I was able to walk to everything. Transportation is just a minute from the house if you prefer that. The room has a great view of the city and the home itself is very clean. I’d definitely stay here again.

Frederika was a warm welcoming person. She is very caring and would ask if you needed anything and was very communicative.Her baby girl, Alex was also welcoming and entertaining. The room had a nice view of london and very spacious. I would recommend Frederika to any person wanting to be her guest.
It is in a good location and Frederika is very friendly and knowledgeable about the area.

I had a comfortable stay at Frederika's apartment. It has terrific views of the city and a great location. She and her daughter are very nice and do their best to make their guests feel at home. Would recommend.

Frederika was the perfect host and her 2 kids are lovely! I felt very welcomed from the moment I step my foot into her house. The check in/out and communication throughout my time there was smooth, quick and easy. The room was spacious and the view was beautiful, I would wake up everyday, look outside and instantly be in a good mood. Location was excellent! We can walk to so many great places plus there are nice restaurants, cafes and grocery shops around. The toilet is shared, but it was kept clean the entire time. If you go to London on a solo trip like me, you MUST stay at Frederika’s :)

Frederika's home is exactly matched the picture shown. She's so warm and kind. I recommend this place for any girl or woman travel alone in London. You'll feel safe like being in your home. Her place is near both Old street (3-5 mins walk) and Moorgate(5-7 mins walk)​. The Old street is closer but I recommend anyone with a large luggage walk from Moorgate because this station has a lift and escalator). You can check the 'avoid-stairs-tube guide'​ from official TFL website. You can walk from Fred's place to Tower of London or St.Paul too. The check-in time is quite strict on workdays, ask her first if you want early check-in or anything. However I suggest if you arrive London in the morning of workday, you have a plenty of time before check-in, you can find a bagBNB or any place to drop your bag. Also, this place is so close to Cass Business School and 15 mins walk to Aldersgate's site, if you are a Cass's student looking for some places to stay before your dorm's open, this is the best place for you. This place has 2 Wifi hotspot: one in the living room (ask password from fred)​ and the other one in your bedroom (password is shown in your AirBNB's confirmation)​ . So whereever you stay in her place you will get the strong wifi signal. I really recommend Fred's place to anyone who read this and I hope to visit her again!
Great place to stay, right in the heart of the action. Frederika was friendly and helpful and Alex was a cutie!
Had a great stay at Frederika's
Homely, hospitable, great views, lovely comfortable bed and stylish bathroom.
Simply wonderful
Great communication and great to chat to. The room was clean, as described and with an amazing view over East London. I had a fantastic stay and it's central. Definite recommend!
Frederika and Alex were wonderful hostesses; gracious and kind. The bedroom is comfortable, with the bed offering a good night's sleep. Staying here was a joy.
Great location, lovely host, construction work didn't bother me at all. I loved the view from my room window. I would happily stay there again!

Perfectly placed flat for Old Street, Frederika was very friendly and little Alex too. The room is excellent; it has a comfortable double bed, wifi, desk, hanging space, fresh towels, toiletries, hairdryer, books, and a large window with a great view over East London.
If that's not enough, The Artillery Arms is next door for beer and scotch eggs. Great value.
I felt very welcome from the beginning. Spent 3 nights there and appreciated the openness, the family atmosphere and the respect of privacy. Thank you for hosting me!

Frederika provided a friendly welcome and communication was excellent.
During my visit, the comfortable and relaxed atmosphere made me feel very much at home. I loved chatting with Frederika and her adorable daughter and I’m looking forward to my next stay. Thank you Frederika and Alex.

Frederika's apartment is ideally located, very cosy and comfortable. The view from the room is amazing. Frederika and Alex were very welcoming and easy to communicate with. I would definitely consider Frederika's place for another stay
Another easy stay at Frederika's. Very convenient for work with great views over London from the room.
Like all the other reviews say, Frederika really does provide a warm welcome to her hosts. Shame I could only stay for one night, highly recommend :)
Frederika was very welcoming and friendly. The room is private. Her daughter is lovely. Location is not far from underground just walk 5 minutes. I will stay this place again if I back to London.

I was lucky enough to be able to stay at Frederika's place for 2 nights whilst in London for a conference. The location of Frederika's place is better than most hotels! It's less than a 2 minute walk to Old Street tube station. So getting around to anywhere in London is amazingly easy, with most journey's being under 20 minutes. The area itself is quite like the Northern Quarter in Manchester, just bigger. Frederika is an amazing & caring host to make sure you have everything you need for a comfortable stay. Alex is such a lovely little girl, very outgoing - if you're lucky enough you might get to meet Alex's friend, Gruffalo (who drinks a lot of tea!) :) I would recommend those looking for a boozy stay in London to consider staying somewhere else though - though anyone looking for somewhere to stay for work perhaps, Frederika's place is much nicer & a lot more fun than staying in a faceless hotel on your own. Thanks Frederika & Alex!
Fedorika is hospitable and her daughter is very cute.
Thanks! It has been a nice stay

Frederika is a welcoming host and Alex must be one of the best behaved one year olds around. The room is clean and warm, with great views, all as described, and there's plenty of hot water in the bathroom. It's in a large local authority block, with good security and the locals I met were friendly and welcoming. Recommended.

Frederika's apartment was perfect for me for a weekend in London. The view is amazing, as promised, and the bedroom spacious and comfortable. The location couldn't have been better - close to multiple tube and train stations for quick access to anywhere in the city. And, it's walking distance to the hip Shoreditch neighborhood for dinner/drinks at night. I also enjoyed chatting with Frederika and her adorable daughter over coffee each morning. Definitely recommend!

Frederika is very welcoming! She was there to open the door when I arrived and the room was even better than I expected. The view is both from the living room and the bedroom which is awesome. It is very quiet and could get a good night of sleep after flying overnight. I would book again without hesitation.

I'm really glad I picked Frederika's home for my first solo trip to London.
The bedroom and bathroom were spotless and had all the amenities I needed. Frederika was super responsive throughout.
She graciously offered many tips for sightseeing around the city. The location, as the listing describes, is a great one. You have a tube stop, bus stop and many bars and restaurants all a 5-10 minute walk away.
All in all, would highly recommend this property!

Frederika was really nice and helpful during my stay. Her apartment has amazing views, the bedroom is big and clean. She made my entry and exit really easy. The neighborhood is full of places for eating and drinking. Plus there are good underground and bus connections.

I stayed at the location due to proximity to the areas of London that I wanted I see (public transport to central London is easy and walking to the shoreditch area is painless). First off, the bedroom has an excellent view and building is in a neighborhood that is interesting and convenient in its own right. The stay was everything I had expected and was very pleasant. No issues with the bathroom/wifi/checkin/any of the other basic items.
I really enjoyed interacting with the host and her lovely/adorable young daughter. I expect that if you are even slightly ok with kids, you will enjoy your time at this great airbnb.

Frederika's place is very well located, with everything easy to reach by walk or transport. Fredericka is a very nice and effective host providing all tge needed advice and support. I do recommend this place to other travelers.

Living in this place is have Convenient transportation, when you from airport to this place, you can take coach or subway to near you live . And close your place, there are have 55bus can going to Oxford cross, it's the main shopping area, and this areas is close some travel sight; and the old street subway is nice to take you where ever you like,
and if you like walking to visit the city, you can go around near you live, like Bank area, in this area you can visit the different life and it close the Bridge of London, chose you like, the different ways can make you surprise!
Live in this apartment you can feel here like your home, Mrs. Frederika is a nice house owner, if you have any problems don't worry she could find ways! And she has a very sweet baby, she was have a good smile! Lovely!!
That is my a month lived experience, it is so much lovely memories in London, hope you're like it!

lovely quiet place, nicest thant I expect and location is sooo god next to shoreditch, plenty of pubs and restaurants.
frederika and her daughter are lovely.
Great location, clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend and stay again.

Flat as described, walking distance from Shoreditch and Saint Paul's Cathedral, close to tube station. Frederika is very nice, welcoming me late with a cup of tea, providing me with directions before and during my stay. And baby Alex is very sweet and quiet. Will choose Frederika's home again if i need to come back to London.
Loved it, wonderful host and an absolutely amazing view from the bedroom
Frederika was a great host, very helpful, really enjoyed chatting with her and her adorable two year old. Perfect location, clean room, in quiet residential area close to everything.
Very nice flat, the view is amazing and Frederika was a very kind host.
Wonderful location, wonderful flat, and a wonderful host with a wonderful daughter.

I highly recommend staying Frederika's Spectacular views. I really enjoyed my time there. I felt very welcome and at home throughout my stay. Underground access was close and hence it was easy to get around. Frederika provided excellent information both in terms of how to transit from various airports, spare time activities, and shopping possibilities.

If you are considering a stay in London I would highly recommending staying at Frederika's.

Great location with a view and walking distance to many attractions. Pity that I couldn't stay any longer. One of the better beds I had for my Airbnb trips.
Thank you and Alex for being such warm and gracious hosts.

Frederika's place is very centrally located in London, and the area contains lots of nearby places to get food and drinks. The apartment itself is very stylish, with a wooden interior that reminds one of staying in a log cabin, but coupled with modern amenities. Her daughter Alex gave a very thorough introduction of the room, and was a joy to be around. Highly recommended for anyone needing a quiet place to stay!
Incredible host! Endless advice about any London topic, especially the immediate area.  Very accommodating to my odd check-in and check-out hours.  Recommend to anyone!
Frederika & Alex are fantastic hosts! Would definitely stay again!
Great location and easy walk into the City of London area.  Great bars and restaurants near by. Frederika is a great host, easy and flexible check in. Nice and quite room very comfy bed.

The neighborhood has a great many restaurants within 5 minutes. Some locations close a bit early but this seems fairly common unless you're near Trafalgar or similar. The bars stay open later. I found the room and restroom to be clean and her to be very hospitable.
Frederika was lovely and welcoming.  Great room and amazing flat.  It was a flying visit for me but the room was perfect!
Super clean and great location. Frederika was very accommodating.
Fabulous location and delightful host. Would stay again!
Very nice host, and lovely flat with iconic views over the impressive London cityscape. Thanks for the stay!

Either Frederika and her place is great! Based in central London and next to transportation, the location is really an outstanding advantage of this property. Frederika's hospitality and the fabulous amenities also make me feel good during my stay. Strongly recommend.

Frederika was a fantastic host.
Gently, warm, and verry helpfull.
We were welcomed with tea and there was also beer...
She helped us with allot of things and borrowing a thermos and an umbrella.
The apartment was clean, cozy and very well situated. It has a breathtaking view on the city.
Public transport around the corner.
After a long day it was great to come "home" and enjoy the great view and sleep in the comfortable bed.
This will be our address in London in the future.
We defenetley come back to Frederica and sweet litle Alex!!!
Frederika was een fantastish hoost!!!
Aardig, warm, interesant bijzonder en heel erg behulpzaam.
We werden verwelkomt met een kop thee! En stond zelfs een koud beertje voor ons klaar!!!
Ze heeft ons enorm geholpen met veel dingen, thermoskan en paraplu geleend... Heel erg atent!!!
De apartament is schoon, knus en super goed gesitueerd. Met een aadembenemend uitzicht op de stad! openbaar vervoer om De hoek, maar we konden alles loopend berijken dus niet eens een kaart voor De openbaar vervoer hoefen te kopen!
Na lange dag en veel lopen was het heerlijk om in het comfortabel bed te gaan liggen en van het spectaculaire uitzicht naast je bed te genitten!
Dit word voortan ons plekje in Londen
Waar we met plezier weer naar terugkomen en kunnen zien hoe de lieve kleine schattige Alex is gegroeid!!!
Had a great stay. Very convenient location and Frederika was very flexible and communicative. She provided lots of recommendations on what to do.

Frederika est une très bonne hôte, elle est toujours de bon conseil si vous avez besoin d'une info sur quoi que ce soit, la chambre est propre et on y trouve tout ce dont on a besoin y compris un sèche cheveux ;) la vue sur Londres est très agréable. Je recommande !!!
Yet another perfect stay, really nice place to stay with a great balance of welcoming and privacy

This flat is located in a heart of London, metro station, supermarkets, restaurants, bars, and many famous destinations are within walking distance. The room is clean, sunny and cozy. And all necessary equipments are provided. View from the window is splendid. The host, Frederika is very kind and friendly. ( And her baby is so cute )
This room is quite reasonable and recommendable.

Frederika was very responsive, accepted my last minute booking and provided clear directions to the flat.
The flat location is excellent, very close to Old Street and bus stops. Room is spacious and airy, bathroom is brand new with a nice shower.
The baby was very happy and relaxed, extremely quiet!
Recommend and would stay again.
The area is safe and easily walkable to St. Paul’s, the Barbican, and Old St. tube station.

Frederika made everything very easy. View was nice and room was very private. I really needed a rest during my stay so it was perfect for that. I definitely would consider staying again if I'm back in the area!
Highly recommended as a friendly, convenient and great place to stay
Frederika’s appartment is ideally located and the room is just perfect for single travellers. Frederika is a nice and welcoming host, ready and happy to help. I definitely recommend her place!

Frederika was lovely and Alex was very cute. The view from the bed is very nice. Makes you feel good about waking up in the morning. It's a place to stay if you want to feel like you are staying with a family. If you are sensitive to sound while sleeping and you like to stay in bed until late, it may not be the right place, since Alex wakes up early (around 7-8am). But otherwise, I recommend without hesitation!
Place is as advertised, it's homely and cosy:) Bathroom is clean and room is quiet. Overall a great place to stay!
Wonderful hospitality and local knowledge.  Highly recommended.
